info.name: Mastodon - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description:
https://mastodon.social/explore and https://mstdn.social/explore

A terminal-inspired theme for mstdn.social and mastodon.social, including Explore.
It carries over grid, scan lines, terminal
font stack and green palette. Frosted side rails, readable menus, glowing
navigation, tinted post cards and matching scrollbars carry the look across the
main web interface. The stylesheet leaves post media in its original colors.
